Authentic South Indian Food and Excellent Service in Hanoi
Oct 2026 • Business
During my business trip to Hanoi, I had a wonderful dining experience at Tadka 2 South Indian Restaurant. The restaurant offers delicious and authentic South Indian food, with a great selection of dishes such as Masala Dosa, Idli, Medu Vada, and other traditional specialties. The food was flavorful, freshly prepared, and reminded me of the authentic tastes of South India.

The service was friendly and attentive, and the restaurant had a comfortable atmosphere, making it a perfect place to enjoy a satisfying meal after a busy working day.

If you are visiting Hanoi for business or leisure and looking for authentic South Indian cuisine, I highly recommend Tadka 2 South Indian Restaurant. I will definitely visit again on my next trip to Hanoi!

A Regular Visitor – Great South Indian Food at Tadka 2 ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Sep 2026 • Business
I visit Hanoi every month for business meetings, and during my regular trips I discovered Tadka Indian Restaurant. I have always enjoyed the food and service, so this time I decided to try their other branch, Tadka 2 – South Indian Food.

I was very happy with the experience. The South Indian food was authentic, fresh, and full of flavour. The dosa, idli, vada, sambar, and chutneys were delicious and reminded me of the authentic tastes of South India.

The staff were friendly, attentive, and welcoming, and the service was smooth and professional. It is great to have both North Indian and South Indian options available in Hanoi.

As someone who visits Hanoi regularly for business, Tadka 2 is definitely a place I would recommend to anyone looking for authentic South Indian food.

I will definitely be coming back on my next business trip to Hanoi. Highly recommended!

Tadka 2 indian restaurant hanoi Fantastic South Indian Food & Excellent Service for Our Group
Aug 2026 • Business
Our group of 15 from the UK had a fantastic dining experience at Tadka 2 – South Indian Food during our visit to Hanoi. The restaurant offered a warm welcome, excellent service, and authentic South Indian cuisine that exceeded our expectations.

The dosas were perfectly crisp, the sambar and chutneys were full of flavour, and every dish was freshly prepared. Everyone in our group thoroughly enjoyed the meal, with generous portions and a great variety of vegetarian and non-vegetarian options.

The staff were friendly, attentive, and ensured everything was served smoothly despite our large group. The restaurant was clean, comfortable, and conveniently located near Train Street, making it a great place to stop for lunch or dinner while sightseeing.

We highly recommend Tadka 2 to anyone looking for authentic South Indian food in Hanoi. It was a memorable experience, and we will certainly return on our next visit. Thank you to the entire team for your wonderful hospitality!
